label_en: Report unauthorised bank or UPI fraud and freeze funds
note_en: Handbook 5.2: immediate, within 3 working days. Call 1930 and notify the bank.

label_en: Sign the electronic FIR in person
note_en: An electronic FIR must be signed in person within 3 days to be taken on record.
NALSA Reg. 7(2) expected window for Panel Advocate appointment.
Developer must consent within 7 days to enter conciliation.
Handbook 5.2 gives 7 to 15 days; send the demand notice and keep a dated copy.
Handbook 6.1 uses a 15-day notice for deposit refunds.

label_en: Grievance portal SLA (CPGRAMS, SEBI SCORES, Aaple Sarkar)
note_en: Aaple Sarkar uses 21 working days. Mark the date to plan escalation or appeal.

label_en: RBI CMS mandatory pre-step: lender must reply first
note_en: Filing earlier than 30 days can be rejected as non-maintainable.

label_en: SEBI SCORES or RBI CMS filing limit
note_en: Hard filing cutoff from the cause of action or the lender reply.
CPA 2019 Sec. 69. The National Consumer Helpline (1915) does not pause this 2-year clock.

label_en: Civil recovery and IT Act limitation period
note_en: Cutoff for civil recovery suits and cyber prosecution under the Limitation Act and IT Act.
